Yes, please, I'd like the earliest one you have today. Can you also tell me whether I should take ibuprofen in the meantime?
I can't advise on medications, but I'll check for the earliest emergency visit slot today. What is your full name so I can look you up or book the appointment?

Tuesday the sixth at eleven thirty sounds good, since that's the earliest one. Can you book that for me?
Just to confirm: a urgent visit for tooth pain for M**** S**** on Tuesday, October 6th at 11:30 AM, and I'll text the confirmation to the number ending in 2 0 9 3. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, thank you. Before I go, is it okay to take ibuprofen until then?
I can't advise on medications, but I'll finalize your booking now. You're all set for Tuesday, October 6th at 11:30 AM. I've sent you a confirmation text. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Okay, thanks, bye.
Thanks for calling Brightside Dental. Have a great day. Goodbye!

I'll check our payment options for you. We accept cash, all major credit and debit cards, HSA and FSA cards, and CareCredit. Payment is due at the time of your visit, and payment plans are available for treatments over $500.
Okay, thanks. Do you offer any payment plans, or is that just for CareCredit?
We do offer payment plans for treatments over $500, in addition to accepting CareCredit.
Okay, so the payment plans are separate from CareCredit then. Thanks, that's really helpful. Bye now.
Thanks for calling Brightside Dental. Have a great day. Goodbye!
